Game Overview

At its heart, Drop Master is a hyper-casual game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Drop Master doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Drop Master?

Drop Master is a free hyper-casual game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Drop Master free to play?

Yes, Drop Master is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
